test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

A) pH value of saliva: 6.2 - 8

B) pH value of pure blood : 7.35 - 7.45

C) pH value of pure water: 9
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only B**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement **"pH value of pure blood: 7.35 - 7.45"** is **correct**
 
• **It is **because **it reflects the tightly regulated pH range essential for the proper functioning of the human body.**
 
• **Blood with a pH outside this range can disrupt normal cellular functions.**
 
• If blood pH drops below **7.35**, it results in **acidosis**, which can impair organ function and lead to serious health complications.
 
• If blood pH rises above **7.45**, it results in **alkalosis**, which can cause muscle twitching, confusion, and other symptoms.

 [IMAGE: https://www.stlawrencedentistry.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/pH-level.jpg] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **pH value of saliva: 6.2 - 8**

 
 
• **​**The pH of saliva typically ranges from **6.2 to 7.6**, depending on factors like diet, hydration, and health.
 
• While saliva can occasionally reach a pH of 8 in exceptional circumstances (e.g., after consuming certain foods or medications), it is not a standard range.
 
• Hence, the statement **is incorrect** because **8 is an upper extreme rather than a norm**.
 
 
 
• **pH value of pure water: 9**
 
 
• Pure water is neutral and has a pH of **7 at 25°C**. A pH of 9 would indicate a basic or alkaline solution, which is not the case for pure water.
 
• Thus, the statement **is incorrect**.
